rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a state of physical or emotional pain and distress.

example.english: They have been suffering ever since they lost a loved one.
example.traditional: 失去親人之後，佢一直都好痛苦。
example.jyutping: sat1 heoi3 can1 jan4 zi1 hau6 keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 tung3 fu2

rows.note: Use this for the hardship or toil someone has endured, rather than for pain itself.

example.english: They went through years of suffering to raise their children.
example.traditional: 為咗養大幾個仔女，佢捱咗好多年辛苦。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 joeng5 daai6 gei2 go3 zai2 neoi2 keoi5 ngaai4 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 san1 fu2
